title: Sydney Golang Meetup - Rob Pike - Go 2 Draft Specifications
summary: Rob Pike presents the Go 2 draft specifications at the Sydney Golang Meetup, covering the Go 2 process and several proposals including generics. The Q&A contains a well-known exchange about the name of the language.
why: Cited in Go threads for Pike's stance on generics and the Go 2 process, plus an amusing Q&A moment.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Rob Pike had a good talk on the Go 2 process and a few of the proposals
